title: Northern Irish Christmas Pudding
description: A traditional Northern Irish dessert made with a twist of miso giving it a rich and savory flavor. Perfect for the holiday season.

ingredients.name: Miso paste
ingredients.notes: adds a savory twist to the traditional pudding

ingredients.name: All-purpose gluten-free flour
ingredients.notes: make sure to choose a gluten-free flour blend

ingredients.name: Irish whiskey
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a nice depth of flavor

ingredients.name: Glazed cherries
ingredients.notes: dried or fresh, whichever you prefer

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the dried fruits, miso paste, brown sugar, eggs, and flour.
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Add the Irish whiskey, if using, and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake the pudding for 25-30 minutes, or until it's firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted comes out clean.
Remove the pudding from the oven and let it cool completely.
Once the pudding has cooled, top it with the glazed cherries.
Serve the pudding warm, garnished with additional cherries if desired.
